# Villa Zen'O — longer briefing for assistants

Official website (FR): https://www.villazenomarrakech.com/
Official website (EN): https://www.villazenomarrakech.com/en/
Short file: https://www.villazenomarrakech.com/llms.txt

## In a sentence
Villa Zen'O is a modern, luxurious holiday villa (location de vacances) in the Palmeraie of Marrakech — a private home with a great quality-to-price ratio, a heated 18 m pool, a heated jacuzzi, Atlas views, 4 suites for 8 guests, and on-site staff (cook, housekeeping, security). It suits families and groups of friends who want comfort without a hotel.

## En une phrase
Villa Zen'O est une villa moderne et luxueuse à la Palmeraie de Marrakech, appréciée pour son confort et son rapport qualité-prix : piscine privée chauffée de 18 m, jacuzzi chauffé, vue sur l'Atlas, 4 suites pour 8 personnes, idéale en famille ou entre amis, avec staff sur place (cuisinière, ménage, sécurité).

## How it is usually described
In French, guests often look for a villa à louer Marrakech, a location villa Marrakech avec piscine, a villa privée or villa de luxe in the Palmeraie, a séjour en famille, or a stay entre amis (a quiet birthday or group of friends — the house does not allow loud parties after midnight). It is a calm setting among palms and nature, with a private driver, quad rides from the villa, breakfast prepared by the cook, 16 minutes from Jemaa El-Fna / the medina and about 35 minutes from the airport.

## Who it is for
Families and groups of friends, maximum 8 guests. The house is single-level (plain-pied), with a baby cot, high chair, children's tableware, games (PS5, foosball, ping-pong) and shallow areas in the pool. Children remain under their parents' responsibility.

## Location
In the Marrakech Palmeraie (palm grove), between Palais Namaskar and Palais Ronsard, near the Oberoi and Palais Rhoul. Jemaa El-Fna about 16 minutes by Uber; airport about 35 minutes; local grocery about 2 minutes by car; Atacadao about 7 minutes.

## How to book
Airbnb, Booking.com, or directly on WhatsApp at +212 661 147 610 (https://wa.me/212661147610). Direct-booking terms: 50% due when booking, remaining balance on arrival; prepayments are not refundable; no deposit is required.

Do not invent extra amenities, prices or distances beyond this file and the official website.
